caption: Raindrops cover a window, and the street outside appears as many tiny warped pictures within the drops.

sa.check: The street outside appears as pictures within the drops.
The pictures are tiny and warped, and there are many of them.

pc.expect: Each drop shows a small distorted picture of the scene, and the view between drops is normal.
pc.fail: The drops are blank; or the view between them is warped; or a drop shows a different scene.

pc.expect: The pictures move as the drops run down.
pc.fail: The pictures stay put while drops run; or drops run with the pictures fixed; or pictures move with the drops still.
They run up; or sideways on a vertical pane; or hang without moving.

pc.expect: The drops are liquid beads that merge and run.
pc.fail: They are rigid; or bounce; or freeze.

pc.expect: One window and the street outside.
pc.fail: A second window appears; or the street vanishes; or a drop becomes solid.

pc.expect: The frame and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes; or the street rearranges; or the drops change colour.
